question: The product of two co-prime numbers is 119. Their LCM should be:
solution:
**CONCEPT USED:**

Co- prime numbers: The numbers which have no common factors except 1, is called co- prime number.

H.C.F of two co- prime number will always be 1 

L.C.M of two co- prime number will be the product of them

Here L.C.M = Least Common Multiple

 H.C.F = Highest Common Factor

**CALCULATION:**

As, 119 can be factorized as 119 = 17 × 7 

As, 17 and 7 are two- co -prime numbers as they have no common factors except 1

Since, L.C.M of two co- prime numbers are the product of two co-prime numbers 

L.C.M = 17 × 7 = 119

**Hence, L.C.M is 119.**
